module: Selected raw input and mutable-scope snapshot
intent: Observe explicitly selected actual inputs within fixed bounds
expected_result: Detect selected bytes, path identity, HEAD/index and optional identity/lease changes without execution authority

outputs.contract: Detect selected bytes, path identity, HEAD/index and optional identity/lease changes without execution authority

acceptance.check: Real filesystem/Git exact selected bytes, immutable same-instance receipt and unchanged currentness
Index flags, mutations, aliases, symlinks, untracked/ignored selection, oversized reads, stale identity/lease, rejected clocks and timed-out I/O never authorize execution

guards: Own only listed paths; no foreign registry, process, credential or installation changes
No native PASS from compiler/fake acceptance; bind reports to candidate SHA
One heavy check slot; do not duplicate installs

resume.next: Read producer receipts and current plan; implement only owned module
resume.after_change: Independent review, fix findings, bind exact source hashes
